augmentation_vs_source.interpretation: Conditions each augmented record on this same model's decision for its source record. source_agrees__augmented_disagrees is a useful transformation-induced mismatch signal, but still is not manually verified ground truth.

interpretation_warning: Agreement is agreement with one pretrained model, not verified ground truth. Softmax confidence can be miscalibrated, especially under distribution shift.
